description: Na₃Sb₅O₁₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbam space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (2.25 Å) and two longer (2.67 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.84 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-3.02 Å. There are four inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-58°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.11 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-58°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.16 Å. In the third Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-55°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.09 Å. In the fourth Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing SbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-55°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.06 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a water-like geometry to two equivalent Sb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Sb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Sb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to one Na and three Sb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Sb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Sb atoms.
